name: io.github.timohaa/scopewalker-mcp
description: Codebase analysis tools for AI agents: complexity, prop drilling, doc coverage, code smells.

environmentVariables.name: SCOPEWALKER_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated absolute paths the tools may analyze. Takes precedence over the roots the MCP client shares. When unset, the client's roots apply, or the current working directory and system temp if the client shares none.
